method: Read root .com UNIPKG1 footer; validate/decompress actual embedded package via packageformat.read_package; parse N and H; validate and expand Q/C using pack.decode_q. Count each H bank and its threshold units, with mode-3 keys separately. Count all package D row references per selected model. No model execution.

units.states: N states / one H observation bank per state
units.expanded_sequence_actions: sum of actions after backward prefix expansion, not flat integer operands
units.threshold_units: sum H unit counts, excluding declared return keys
units.declared_return_keys: sum mode-3 return set cardinalities, not distinct keys across banks
units.route_row_refs: all package stage-row references to this physical shared model, not only selected route
units.compressed_bytes: stored per-model raw-DEFLATE body, excludes package directory and record headers

scope: Offline structure only. Route totals count six distinct physical models once. All-shared totals count every physical model once. Structure and compressed bytes are specific to the recorded artifact.

dynamic_counts.limitation: Older calc runtime action/step counts are not transferred or extrapolated to these models. No runtime steps, actions, timings or live platform execution measured in this audit.

extraction_python:
import collections, hashlib, pathlib, sys
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'exec/c'))
from packageformat import read_package
from pack import decode_q
artifact = (root / 'unisacc.com').read_bytes()
assert artifact[-16:-8] == b'UNIPKG1\n'
package_bytes = int.from_bytes(artifact[-8:], 'little')
package_offset = len(artifact) - 16 - package_bytes
assert package_offset > 0 and package_bytes > 0
package = artifact[package_offset:-16]
decoded = read_package(package)
refs = collections.Counter(int(row[5]) for row in decoded['rows'])
models = []
for index, text in enumerate(decoded['models']):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    head = lines[0].split()
    assert head[0] == b'N' and len(head) == 7
    states, sequences, registers, strings, start, top = map(int, head[1:])
    qlines = lines[1 + strings:1 + strings + sequences]
    expanded = decode_q(qlines)
    hlines = lines[1 + strings + sequences:]
    assert len(hlines) == states
    units = banks = keys = 0
    for line in hlines:
        words = line.split()
        assert words[0] == b'H'
        values = list(map(int, words[1:]))
        mode, lo, hi, count, base_next, base_sequence = values[:6]
        assert count >= 0
        units += count
        if mode == 3:
            return_sequence, return_count = values[6:8]
            return_keys = values[8:8 + return_count]
            assert 0 <= return_sequence < sequences
            assert return_count > 0 and len(return_keys) == return_count
            assert return_keys == sorted(set(return_keys))
            assert all(0 <= key <= top for key in return_keys)
            assert len(values) == 8 + return_count + 3 * count
            banks += 1
            keys += return_count
        else:
            assert mode in (0, 1, 2) and len(values) == 6 + 3 * count
    wire = decoded['wires'][index]
    models.append(dict(index=index, states=states, sequences=sequences,
        q_records=sum(line.startswith(b'Q ') for line in qlines),
        c_records=sum(line.startswith(b'C ') for line in qlines),
        stored_suffix_actions=sum(int(line.split()[1] if line.startswith(b'Q ') else line.split()[3]) for line in qlines),
        expanded_sequence_actions=sum(map(len, expanded)), threshold_units=units,
        declared_return_banks=banks, declared_return_keys=keys,
        binary_bytes=len(wire['raw']), compressed_bytes=len(wire['stored']),
        route_row_refs=refs[index], binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(wire['raw']).hexdigest(),
        compressed_sha256=hashlib.sha256(wire['stored']).hexdigest()))
route = 'osx/arm64/image/O2'
selected = [dict(stage=row[2].decode(), input=row[3].decode(), output=row[4].decode(),
                 **models[int(row[5])]) for row in decoded['rows'] if row[1].decode() == route]
assert [item['stage'] for item in selected] == ['e2','e1','e3','e4','lower','elf']
assert len({item['index'] for item in selected}) == len(selected)
assert (root / 'unisacc.com').read_bytes() == artifact
